findings.title: Watering requests have no timeout: a hung 'Water now' leaves the button disabled forever with no message
findings.where: Beds page – Water now / Save watering (POST /api/waterings); also GET /api/waterings on dashboard and Waterings page
findings.steps: Open /beds, make POST /api/waterings hang (never respond), click 'Water now'.
findings.expected: The request fails after 10 s, an error shows on the bed, and the button is enabled again.
findings.actual: After 15+ s the button is still disabled. No error or timeout appears. useApiClient/useApiFetch set no timeout.
findings.evidence: Playwright: after 15 s, isDisabled() returned true for the first 'Water now' button.

findings.title: Double click on 'Water now' records two waterings
findings.steps: On /beds, click 'Water now' twice quickly (two clicks in the same tick, before Vue re-renders the disabled state). A retry after a timeout would also duplicate, because there is no idempotency key.
findings.evidence: GET /api/waterings count went from 3 to 5 after one double click.

findings.title: Waterings page error state has no retry; the only way to refetch is to change the filter or reload
findings.steps: Make GET /api/waterings return 500 (non-JSON body), open /waterings directly or through the nav link.
findings.expected: An error message with a Retry button that refetches once the server is back.
findings.actual: 'Could not load waterings.' shows with no retry button. The main area has no buttons. Re-selecting the same filter value does not refetch.
findings.evidence: main buttons list was [] while the error was shown.

findings.title: Dashboard 'Recent waterings' error state has no retry
findings.steps: Make GET /api/waterings fail, then navigate to the Dashboard through the in-app link.
findings.actual: Only 'Could not load recent waterings.' shows. There is no retry button (the refresh function is not even destructured), so the section can only be recovered by reloading the page.
findings.evidence: Section text: 'Recent waterings / All waterings / Could not load recent waterings.'; buttons in the section: [].

findings.title: Bed filter silently shows only 'All beds' when the beds request fails
findings.steps: Make GET /api/beds return 500, then open /waterings via the nav link.
findings.expected: An error saying the bed list could not be loaded, with a retry.
findings.actual: The select has only 'All beds' and no error is shown, so the filter by bed is unusable without explanation. A ?bed=N link shows a blank selection.
findings.evidence: options: ['All beds']; no alert on the page. The bedsResult error is never read.

findings.title: Record-past-watering form is unusable at 375 px: date and litres inputs squashed to ~30 px
findings.steps: Set the viewport to 375x800, open /beds, click 'Record past watering'.
findings.expected: The fields stack and are full width and usable.
findings.actual: .water-form keeps grid-template-columns 1fr 1fr auto with no mobile breakpoint. The date and litres inputs are each about 30 px wide, so you can't see the value you typed.
findings.evidence: Screenshot scratch/playwright/form375.png shows tiny Date/Litres boxes next to the Save/Cancel buttons.

findings.title: Waterings table overflows horizontally at 375 px with a long bed name
findings.steps: Create a bed with a 60-character name without spaces, record a watering for it, and view /waterings at 375 px.
findings.expected: No sideways scrolling; long names wrap.
findings.actual: The page scrollWidth is 997 px. The bed-name cell doesn't wrap and the table has no overflow handling.

findings.title: Today's date refused as 'in the future' for users ahead of the server's time zone; 'Water now' dates use the server's zone
findings.steps: Use a browser in a time zone ahead of the server (e.g. Pacific/Kiritimati), open Record past watering (defaults to the browser's today), enter 3 litres and save.
findings.actual: Error 'Watered on: Watering date cannot be in the future.' The server checks against date.today() in its own zone, and 'Water now' stores watered_on as the server-local date but watered_at in UTC. So the date and the displayed time can disagree, and ordering against past entries (browser dates) is inconsistent around midnight.
findings.evidence: Default date 2026-11-13 in the Kiritimati context; alert text shown above. The form kept the values.

findings.title: Server answers 500 for out-of-range numbers on the new endpoints
findings.actual: 500 Internal Server Error (plain-text body) for all four.
findings.evidence: curl: 'Internal Server Error 500' for each request.

findings.title: Tiny amounts and year-1 dates accepted and shown misleadingly
findings.steps: Record litres 0.001 (the client allows any value > 0, and the server allows gt=0) or watered_on 0001-01-01.
findings.expected: Refused with a reason (e.g. minimum 0.1 L, a plausible date range) or shown accurately.
findings.actual: Accepted. The amount shows as '0 L', and the date shows as '1 Jan 1'.
findings.evidence: Waterings list rows: '12 Nov 2026, 17:57 North bed 0 L' (litres 1e-7) and '1 Jan 1 North bed 1 L'.

findings.title: 'Water now' shows no progress label while the past-watering form is open, and concurrent waterings on two beds share one busy/error state
findings.steps: Open 'Record past watering' on a bed, then click 'Water now' on it with a slow server. Or click 'Water now' on bed A then bed B while A is pending.
findings.expected: 'Watering…' feedback, and independent state per bed.
findings.actual: The button is disabled but still reads 'Water now'. With two beds, wateringBedId/waterError are single refs: B's request re-enables A's button while A is still pending, and B clears A's error.
findings.evidence: Hang test returned button text 'Water now' and disabled=true with the form open; the shared refs are in the beds.vue code.
